Coffee

What is in the cup

From the menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Hot and iced coffee

Cappuccino, americano and mocha, freddo espresso, freddo cappuccino and iced flat white. The large sizes come with three shots.

House shakes

Coffee drinks of their own, with lotus biscuit, cookie or Nutella and fresh cream.

Smoothies and tea

Six smoothies from spinach and apple to mango and pineapple, and teas such as Greek mountain tea.

Croissant with it

Pistachio croissant and a handmade gluten free brownie. Guests also write about the croissants and the lemon muffin.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Friendly baristas

Google counts 31 reviews that mention friendly staff. One guest writes that the barista remembered their order every morning.

Every sixth coffee free

Guests write about a loyalty card: five coffees, then the sixth is free.

Pay by card or crypto

Cards and contactless are accepted, and a sign in the shop says it also takes cryptocurrency.

A small coffee shop on Ermou

TCHITCHI is a small coffee shop with a counter to the street on Ermou, in the shopping streets of the old town, with a few seats outside. Guests write that they stop on the way to the beach or between shops, and that some come back every morning of their holiday.

What guests say

Three of 112 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“Great coffee and impeccable service. Every morning of my holiday I came here for 2 flat whites. The Barista, she always remembered me and my order. On my second day I noticed the coffee loyalty card. 5 coffees then the 6th free. That's so generous!”

Google review
